William Beauchamp, 1st Baron Bergavenny
English nobleWilliam de Beauchamp, 1st Baron Bergavenny was an English peer. Beauchamp was the fourth son of Guy de Beauchamp, 10th Earl of Warwick, and Katherine Mortimer. He served under Sir John Chandos during the Hundred Years' War, and was created a Knight of the Garter in 1376. Sir William Beauchamp served on the royal council of king Richard II as sub-chamberlain or acting chief chamberlain of the household from 1378 to 1380. Beauchamp served as Captain of Calais in 1383. Upon the death of his first cousin once removed, John Hastings, 3rd Earl of Pembroke, on 30 December 1389, William inherited the lordship of Abergavenny, including Abergavenny Castle.
